title: Sudan · Health · 2025-11-18 – 2026-11-18
findings: An estimated 37 percent of health facilities across the country are completely out of service [3], while earlier assessments identified up to 40 per cent as non-operational [6].
Health system contraction has accelerated as severe funding shortfalls force operational facilities to downsize staff, close essential wards, and exhaust critical medical supplies [3].
